story_type: sinking sailboat in heavy seas, sailor in a dinghy, basket hoist
hook: His sailboat was sinking in eleven foot waves.
narration: His sailboat was sinking twenty miles off the Texas coast, in eleven foot waves.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Corpus Christi flew out to find him.
He was fifty years old, and he had already climbed off into a small inflatable.
Survivors who can move on their own ride up in a rescue basket. They climb in, sit down and keep their arms inside.
The crew brought the basket up through the rotor wash and in through the door.
outcome: The Corpus Christi aircrew hoisted him off the sinking sailboat and aboard the helicopter.
title: Sailboat sinking in 11 foot waves
description:
On Jan. 24, 2014, a Coast Guard Air Station Corpus Christi helicopter crew hoisted a 50-year-old man from his sinking sailboat 20 miles offshore of Baffin Bay, Texas, in 11-foot waves.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Stephen Lehmann, U.S. Coast Guard PADET Texas, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/320222/coast-guard-rescues-man-sailboat-beset-weather
